ordering: Node then Rust on odd rounds; Rust then Node on even rounds; same fixture order
bootstrap_unit: paired round; median of paired metric ratios or differences; 2.5th and 97.5th percentile interval
http_connection_policy: One identical pooled HTTP/1 driver client per implementation/workload; no retries; fully consume every response. Mock evaluator/upstream share a separate driver-owned HTTP/1 listener with persistent connections.
driver_build: Optimized release profile required for numerical runs; deterministic --validate may use debug.
execution: Complete serve CLI process with cleared environment, private empty config, synthetic API/local/evaluator keys, loopback-only URLs, no saved configuration, no real providers, no model downloads.

fixture.selected_model: claude-sonnet-5 for small/cache; claude-opus-5-5 retained for large catalog by compatible-profile conservative context guard
fixture.response: fixed complete message with end_turn, input_tokens 32 and output_tokens 8

workload_identity: Each request has an independent prompt ID; miss inputs include round/stage/index, cache input is identical across requests and stages; agent ID rotates modulo concurrency. Large fixture serialized bytes and SHA256 are recorded, not relabeled as an older historical shape.
mock_controls: Measure the exact same HTTP fixture directly against the driver-owned upstream before each gateway pair; retain direct latency and throughput without subtracting independently measured percentiles.
counts: Every measured inference must reach upstream exactly once with expected selected model; misses require exactly one evaluator request per inference, warm cache requires zero. Source and response hashes retained. Large catalog misses require one speculative Haiku count call per inference; other initial workloads require zero. Count endpoint calls are recorded separately.
metrics: Raw elapsed and first-response-byte request samples; duration and requests/sec; ready and clean shutdown milliseconds; idle and sampled peak whole-process RSS; CPU time delta from ps with platform resolution recorded; a per-request CPU estimate is unavailable when accumulated CPU is less than ten resolution units. Missing metrics are null, not zero.
startup_limits: New processes on a warm filesystem/OS cache; not a cold reboot or purged disk-cache experiment. Dispatcher startup is separately qualified by packaging, not measured in this initial native executable run.
memory_limits: 100ms external sampling is a lower bound on peak RSS, so sampled peak cannot approve true peak-memory target. Whole-process RSS includes runtime workers; mock and driver memory are excluded.
environment_limits: Record runtime/compiler and binary/source hashes, OS/CPU/memory, worker configuration, background load and observed power settings before measurements. Uncontrolled workstation runs remain exploratory. No process names, private paths or environment secrets are collected.
acceptance_limits: Only implemented workloads with all expected counts and response bytes are comparable. Pending streaming/cancellation/storage/soak/near-limit workloads, real evaluator quality and other representative platforms keep overall gates incomplete. Never tighten or relax this version based on observed results.
